balls.text: squeezed wide of short third, and SRH end on 286! It was a yorker-length ball angling across, and pitching a little wide of off. Kishan waited for it to arrive, before beating the fielder to his left for four more
just short of the man rushing and diving forward from deep cover! Dubey was the fielder there who moved forward after Kishan sliced this low full toss angling across to arrive around off
shorter side of a length on off, and at a change of pace. Cummins swipes at it towards square leg, seemingly beaten by the lack of pace

gone first ball! Comfortable catch for Parag at long-on... and hopes of SRH crossing 287 start fading. It was a full toss at knee height around middle and off, and Manohar went lofting. But I think he didn't get enough bat swing at the ball. That leaves Deshpande on a hat-trick

taken at fine leg! Archer goes low to grab this just above the ground. It was a slower ball from Deshpande, as he bowled on a length, and around sixth stump. Again, the length was hittable, even as Aniket was deep in the crease, and standing outside off. His front leg was also cleared, but he just couldn't dispatch the ball this time
dropped by Farooqi! And with that, there's also six for Aniket! Short in length, and around off, as Aniket got on top of the bounce to hook it hard for six over deep square leg

hundred for Kishan! His first in IPL! He looks pumped up, and appreciates the applause after a loud roar. The ball was full and straight, and he drilled it down the ground. The fielder at long-off moved to his left to keep this to two. But the moment is all Kishan's for now, as he raises a 45-ball hundred
six over fine leg! Kishan on 98! Short in length from Sandeep, who bowled this around middle and leg. But Kishan swivelled and hooked firmly for six

swiped just over the man at deep-backward square leg! Farooqi, the fielder there, kept watching the ball until the last moment, before realising that the ball was hit well enough. It was a low full toss around middle and leg, as Kishan swung with the line
short in length, and wide of off. Aniket gets across, and swats it towards long-off by getting on top of the bounce

taken at long-on! Klaasen looks frustrated! He went slightly across the stumps, and was deep in the crease, before he went lofting at this length delivery just outside off. The length seemed perfect to dispatch the ball by heaving it away, but Klaasen found Parag, who was standing bang at the edge of the boundary
on a length, and wide of off. Klaasen gets across, and sweeps it to deep square leg. Jaiswal chases it to his right from deep midwicket

flashed to deep-backward point! Whatever Archer bowls goes for a boundary, whatever SRH batters hit gets them four or six! Archer bowled on a length, but wide enough outside off for Kishan to cut it away to the left of the man at short third. It was out of reach for deep cover too. Archer's four overs go for 76!!
on a full length on middle and off. He looked to launch it back, but got an inside edge on to his pad. The batters were alert enough to pinch a quick single

wide of long-off! The fielder moved and dived to his left, but in vain! That is also SRH's 250 up with more than two overs to go. Short in length from Archer, who again went on a slightly wider line outside off. Klaasen rode the bounce, and creamed it for four more
bottom edge, and wide of the keeper! It was a dipping yorker around sixth stump, and as Klaasen looked to drill it away, and the ball ran away between the keeper and short third
swatted over extra cover! Archer bowled from wide of the crease, and went short and wide of off. It seemed like a back-of-the-hand slower ball, but Klaasen read it timely to smash it for four
taken at long-off... but it doesn't matter! Archer bowled full and wide of off, and Kishan reached out while playing away from his body. He ended up finding the fielder, and getting a single

bowls a high full toss! It is called no-ball, and the along with the batter, the keeper is beaten too. So that is also four bonus runs for SRH. The ball arrived around fifth stump, and as Kishan looked to attack, he swayed out realising the height of the ball
sliced over short third! He shaped to go back, before moving forward and opening the face of the bat at this fullish ball around sixth stump
crashed over deep midwicket! Slower ball from Sandeep, but the length is on the shorter side and the line just outside off. Klaasen shifts his weight back, and clubs it for six

excellent ball! Sandeep appeals for lbw, but it is turned down! Klaasen got deep in the crease early, and Sandeep fired a yorker on off. Klaasen looked to whip but missed, and replays suggest he was struck outside off
on a length, and he keeps bowling wide outside off. Klaasen hacks at it towards deep extra cover for two
angles this across from over the wicket, and bowls fullish and wide of off. Kishan throws his bat at it to chip towards long-off
bowls on a length, but pretty wide of off. Klaasen reaches out and slashes to deep cover
drilled to long-off
reaches out to waft at this slower length ball, they pick up a single
looks to flay this short and wide delivery through point, ends up getting a thick outside edge to beat short third.
looks to drill this over long-off, but gets a thick outside edge as the ball lands towards third man
slapped straight to cover for a single
looks to walk across and sweep him behind square but misses. Deshpande slanted it across, but it's been called wide. Jurel wants this to be reviewed. Umpires deem it to be a wide.
drills this low full toss over mid-off, Riyan with a valiant effort but this just manages to elude him. Kishan got the bottom of the bat but still managed to pick up a boundary
advances down the pitch and whips this low full toss down to deep midwicket
plays the switch hit between point and short third! Waited for the ball to drift in, changed his stance and used his wrists to perfection as he picked the hap
chops this down to point
punched to sweeper cover to get off the mark
whips this straight down Jaiswal's throat at deep midwicket. He had to come in quite a long way from the boundary and was on the move when he caught that. Well taken.

pushed through full and wide outside off, left alone in anticipation of a wide call. Not given and Nitish sends this upstairs. Adrian Holdstock, the umpire, will have to overturn his decision by the looks of it....yep, yep. He has.
fires one on a length outside off, Nitish has a big swipe at it but gets a thick edge that flies over the keeper's head for four.
drifts across a length ball away from Nitish's swinging arc, manages to beat him on the pull. Wide called. RR don't review
full toss angling in and he's helped this along to pick the gap at deep backward square leg.
walloped down to long-on

sat up nicely for Nitish to pump him over deep square leg! Easy pickings. Poor bowling from Farooqi - the batters have messed with his mind and execution. Nitish held his shape and then put that slower ball away
wide yorker from around the stumps, dug out
drilled to sweeper cover

clears deep backward square leg! It's Farooqi's turn to come under Kishan's wheel. Bowls full on middle from wide of the crease, Kishan tries to get inside the line and plays the pick-up shot to perfection as he clears the ropes.
bunts it into the off side for a single

goes full on middle from wide of the crease, Kishan makes room and exhibits a terrific hand-eye coordination to launch this inside-out to hit this flat and clear deep cover. Wow, remarkable stroke play
attempts a slower bouncer but loses control of it and ends up bowling way outside off, was also way over the batter's head. Wide called
squeezed down to long-on
slapped away to deep point
pummelled over deep cover! Brings up a stunning 25-ball half-century on SRH debut. Backs away, gets underneath the length and lofts him over cover. Jeez, what power. Raw bottom-handed power.

Jofra's return to the IPL isn't proving to be a memorable one so far! Kishan goes through with the pick-up shot and ends up getting a top-edge that sails over the keeper's head. Jofra has a wry smile on his face
reaches out to dab this slower delivery to point, scampers a run that would've only ben cut short if there was a direct hit at the bowler's end. Nitish Rana with the throw. Kishan was struggling.

skinny length ball outside off, Kishan reaches out to cut but misses. This has been called wide, but RR ain't happy with the call. So they review. Didn't seem like it was a wide to the naked eye. and replays confirm as much. So the wide call will have to be overturned
takes pace off as he bowls a slower length ball, but loses direction by spraying this way outside off, Kishan reaches out to cut but misses. Another wide.
dug in short, way over Kishan's head as he bails out of the pull, wide signalled
swatted away down the ground, Riyan and Hetmyer give it chase to hurl the ball. Hetmyer ran around from long-on and put in a dive to scoop the ball back in.

it's a good, old hoick across the line, Nitish is furious at his choice of stroke. Gets more elevation than distance and Jofra made the mistake of running around the ropes rather than getting to the ball at deep midwicket. That split-second decision cost him a catch and RR a wicket
slower bouncer outside off, Nitish pulls it towards deep midwicket. Theekshana comes around from deep square to cut that off
flat-batted to long-on

how has he picked the gap? Wow, what power! Jofra bowls a slower bouncer, off the back of the hand, and Nitish holds his shape and swats this away into the gap between wide long-on and deep midwicket.
advances down the pitch as Jofra digs one in to cramp him for room, bunted down the ground
pushed wide of cover for a quick single
crrrrrraaaaack! Backs away to give himself room and slaps him over the infield to pick the gap at deep cover.
arches back and ramps this short ball down to third man on the bounce
excellent effort from Parag at mid-off to get to the ball, but this lands just short as Nitish looks to go through the line over the infield
punches to mid-off as they scamper a single. Jaiswal attempts a direct hit at the bowler's end, misses.
slapped back past the bowler, beats mid-off and it bullets down the ground. Deshpande immediately puts his hand out to apologise to his skipper Riyan Parag
beaten by the short ball as he tries to fetch the pull from outside off

drills this straight to mid-off.  Head reaches out to scythe this over cover but can't get the kins of bat on it as he'd like, Hetmyer takes an excellent catch. Good use of the knuckleball from Deshpande. The pace off clearly did its trick on Head as he went through with the shot.

bludgeons this down the ground! Deshpande tries to take it away from Head's hitting arc but he somehow still manages to reach out and flat-bats it over the bowler's head. Nearly cleared the ropes as well as he hit it dead straight.
reaches out to slap this through cover as Deshpande slants it across, bails out as it's far too wide.
cuts, lands just short of point. A half-stop means they take a single. Kishan didn't go through with the cut, somehow stopped himself.
starts with a slower length ball he bowls way outside the wide line, Kishan leaves
heaves and misses. Sandeep cleverly takes pace off and bowls it outside Head's hitting arc.
backs away and slaps this slower bouncer over cover. Like a tennis forehand . This seemed like it bounced over his head but Travis held his shape and slapped it when it arrived
reaches out to toe-end this straight hit down to long-off
yorker-length, gets this to rail late from middle, squeezed to backward point
whipped away off the pads down to deep backward square leg. Incredible bat speed and wrist work all at once

short ball, Sandeep takes pace off, so there's spongy bounce, Head looks to slap it over point but because he has no pace, just wafts at that to get a top edge. Sandeep runs the entire length of the pitch to try and catch that but just misses out. Nearly a catch but again, luck not going RR's way
rocks back and fetches the pull from way outside off, down to deep midwicket
flat hit down to long-on. Looked to clear the ropes but didn't get the elevation
cut to deep cover as he jogs the single
lofted over extra cover! Rana bowls a harmless length ball outside off, Head stands his ground and lofts him through the line. Pristine timing and placement
works it down to long-on
slaps it to wide long-off, Head brings up a 21-ball fifty

Shubham Dubey at deep point can't take the catch at deep point! Gets to the ball in time but can't bend down in the nick of time to take the catch as the ball dribbles away to the ropes. Hint of hesitation from the fielder, because he was a tad late to get off the blocks as Kishan absolutely slapped that up and over.
bludgeoned down the ground over the bowler's head once again
clears his front leg and blasts this straight back past the bowler. Long-on and long-off converge to cut that off. Jaiswal put in the dive from long-off, parrying to Hetmyer at long-on.
full on the stumps, drilled down to long-on.
length on the stumps, defended

starts with an absolute half-tracker that Kishan wallops in front of square, deep midwicket comes around to try and cut that off but can't. Excellent effort from Kunal Singh Rathore, who ran nearly 25 yards around the ropes.
a low full toss on the stumps... and four more! He simply made a bit of room, and lofted it back down the ground. That is 94 in the first six overs!
oohh, he backed away and looked to slog sweep, but the ball was full and seemed to come on with the arm after pitching outside leg. So Head was hit on his pad... but, but it's a no-ball!
full and pretty quick on off, as it straightens after pitching. Nudged towards midwicket
long-off is back, and Head slaps this length ball pitching on off and turning in for a single in that region
this dips and lands as a low full toss on middle. Pushed to mid-on for a hurried single
between cover point and extra cover! Shorter side of a length just outside off, and it turns away, before Kishan hacks it for four more
misfield, and four more! Short of a length, and wide of off, as Kishan cuts it hard only for the ball to slip between Jaiswal's legs at cover point

one-bounce four! This one went down the ground! Archer angled this in from around the wicket, and went on a fullish length on the stumps. But the fact that Head is deep in the crease and is standing with his front leg out of the way means he can slam that back rather easily

swatted over mid-off! I have no option other than to explain what happened even as my fingers are paining already. Shorter side of a length, and just around off or thereabouts, as Head backs away to thrash that
wide called, and Archer isn't pleased! He banged a bouncer on pretty much a stump-to-stump line, and the ball shaped back in. The bounce seemed too much indeed, and Head missed as he looked to ramp
slashed between cover point and extra cover! Archer gives Head some width again, and bowls on the shorter side too. Head waits for it before shifting his weight back, and slaps it away
slower ball, and beaten! On a shortish length, and in the corridor outside off, as Head looked to have a hack, but missed out

bam! Massive hit over deep square leg! Beware in the crowd! Archer bowled on the shorter side again, and this arrived around middle. Head, standing outside leg, had a liberal swing of the bat to pull for six
whipped over the man at square leg! Archer bowled this on the shorter side of a length on leg, and Head, after backing away, flicked that effortlessly for four
very quick from Theekshana - at 104kph - as he bowled short on middle, and the ball went on with the angle from around the wicket to hit Kishan's pad as he looked to pull but missed
full and straight, and this time Kishan heaves across the line. He mistimes the shot, and ends up dribbling the ball wide of mid-on for two
bashed over the umpire's head! Much fuller and quicker, and on off, as Kishan this time belts it back for four

ooh, some luck going Kishan's way! Extra bounce for Theekshana, and there's no slip to pouch that outside edge. Kishan was hanging deep in the crease, and the ball was on a fullish length on off. It turned away and bounced, and Kishan jabbed at it tentatively
quite full, and on the stumps. Driven back down the pitch, and Theekshana throws himself to his left to stop a potential single

taken at cover point! Jaiswal only had to grab it with both hands after moving a step to his right! Theekshana bowled a short delivery which was wide enough for any batter to slap for a boundary, only for Abhishek to end up slashing it away from his body to break another stunning stand with Head. RR and I can take a breather, at least for now
launched over backward point! Typical Travis Head style, as he stands after backing away, and targets this fullish ball arriving around sixth stump. He throws his bat powerfully, and belts it for six
a full toss arriving on middle as the ball swings in, and is driven to long-on

a high, inswinging full toss which arrives wide of leg, and Abhishek, after making room, ends up swiping it over square leg. The umpires did wonder for a while if it was a no-ball for height, but it's not given eventually
pulled over midwicket! A hat-trick of boundaries this over! Farooqi switched his length to go short, and around fifth stump. The ball didn't get up a lot, as Abhishek thrashed it for another boundary
over mid-off this time! On a length on middle, and Abhishek, with his front leg out of the way, flings it for four more

just over the man at backward point! It was swatted over the fielder, even as Abhishek, who had made room early, had to adjust for the bounce and also after being cramped for room. Farooqi went short and got it to shape in and finish wide of leg, before Abhishek swatted it away
full, and just outside off. That was quicker too, and Head ended up driving to the man at extra cover

down the pitch, and bang! The first six off Head's bat this season! Theekshana went much fuller - perhaps right around that hittable length - on middle and off, and Head launched it over his, well, head
slapped between point and cover point! Shorter side of a length, and on fifth stump, as Head shifts his weight back to find the gap for four. The ball, in fact, straightened after pitching
ahhh, fuller and slower! He goes on a fullish length on off, and Heads chips this towards extra cover
fullish length, and angled in to to pitch just outside off. Slashed on the bounce to cover point
on a length again, but wide of off. This time Head throws his bat at it, and ends up mistiming a loft wide of long-off
on a length, and really wide of off. Wide called, even as Head seemed to back away
on a length, and quite quick around sixth stump. Punched towards point... and the siren goes off to inform that it's a no-ball
another full toss from Farooqi, although this is lowish, and around fourth stump. Heaved away behind square to get off the mark
much fuller length, and this one again swings sharply to arrive on a very full length on the stumps. Flicked hard to fine leg
through cover point! On a length on middle, and Abhishek made room early to dispatch that between point and cover point for four more
I thought that was too much inswing, and that is whipped for four! It landed as a full toss which was dipping around off, and Abhishek swung it wide of mid-on to get things going
ohh, superb yorker! This is angled in but swings away to arrive bang on the base of off stump, before Abhishek digs it out off the outside half of the bat
angles this in from over the stumps, and goes on a fullish length around middle and off. Abhishek pushes it to mid-on with no foot movement

squeezes this yorker-length delivery to long-on.  Game, set and match to the Sunrisers!  But hats off to the Royals for making a game of this, and coming within 50 runs of victory. They've minimised their margin of defeat and saved their net run rate - which could've nosedived massively to leave them playing catch up. That's not the case, they can walk away with plenty to take away from this match.

another short ball this one's cramped Hetmyer as he goes through with the flat-batted hit, the top-edge lodges safely in the hands of mid-off. Harshal went proper seam-up this time, as against a cutter, and got it to skid through. Clever change of tactic and he gets a second wicket.
flat-batted over the bowler's head, smack the sightscreen. The power!
digs in a slow bouncer around a fifth-stump line anticipating the batter to swing across the line, Hetmyer leaves. Umpire deems it to be a wide
scythed to deep point for a single. Stayed deep inside the crease to get underneath the length and opened the bat face late to hit it there.
top-edge, the ball swirls a long time and Cummins puts him down running sideways at mid-off. Should've been taken
beaten as he's through with the hoick even before the ball arrived
pulled to deep midwicket
mistimes the pull, the top-edge plonks near the 30-yard circle at midwicket, they come back for the second.
my word! He has walloped him over deep midwicket! Cummins bowls length into the stumps from around the stumps and Hetmyer swings through the line to hit it a mile int he air and beyond the ropes.
bowls a slower bounced but ends up digging it way outside off, Hetmyer leaves and it's called wide
mistimes this pull, gets it off the bottom, down to deep midwicket
drags this hoick don to deep midwicket - Cummins has overstepped.
sliced over the infield, down to third man on the bounce

floats it full and wide outside off, Hetmyer leaves in anticipation of a wide, and wide it is. Sunrisers review. Let's see. Umpire reckons some part of the ball is within the guideline, so the wide call has been reversed.

too short and he's pulled him into he gap at deep square. Ishan Kishan with a desperate dive but he can't stop that. He limps across the advertising triangles. Jarred his knee into the turf thanks to the dive
drilled over long-off! Flat hit. Zampa bowled it full and across, Dubey shuffled across to get to the pitch and launched it up and over.  50 partnership up off just 22 balls
mistimes a heave down to long-on, didn't get underneath the flight that time
heaved to deep midwicket and he clears the ropes comfortably! It was a wrong'un, he was hitting it not just across the line but also towards the longer boundary. Hit it wonderfully.
drifts it across in a bid to bowl it outside Hetmyer's hitting arc, ends up bowling it too wide outside off
hammered down the ground, hit ramrod straight. Long-on was a few metres away but stood no chance
slapped back to Zampa who stops it off his own bowling
muscled down the ground and clears long-on! Didn't get it off the middle, the sound off the bat told you so, but hey, he still hit it enough to get six.

goes full and wide, but Dubey stays his ground and opens the bat face late to scythe this yorker-length delivery over deep cover point. Cummins missed his length by an inch or two. Wow, incredible power
flat-batted to long-on
my word! That's bludgeoned past the bowler, umpire is quick to duck under the flat hit. Abhishek and Ishan converge from long-on and long-off to cut that off
squeezed over point off a leading edge, down to square third
clobbered over deep midwicket! Cummins decides to bowl into the pitch but Dubey's waiting and gives it a proper whack when it arrives.
beaten! Harshal bowls another short ball at a change of pace, and Hetmyer, looking to pull, did so too early
short ball around seventh stump, and Dubey mistimes a ramp towards deep third
short again, and wide of off too. Hetmyer pulls to long-on, with the line being too wide to execute that shot properly
Dubey gets across the stumps, and pulls this short-of-a-length ball shaping in to arrive on leg. Single to fine leg
short in length this time, with the line being wide of off. Hetmyer swat-pulls to long-on, nearly foxed by the lack of pace
bowls an inswinging yorker just outside off, and Hetmyer can only jam it towards mid-off
full and skidding through on off. He goes back to clip to deep midwicket
cracked over deep midwicket! Zampa went full and just outside off, and Hetmyer got down on his back knee to launch for six
lovely ball! He slows it down, and goes fullish and just outside off. The ball turns away a bit, and beats the outside edge as Hetmyer looked to defend
on fullish length on middle, and turns away a bit. Clipped to deep square leg after shifting his weight back

taken at long-on! Jurel falls going for a slog sweep. Zampa bowls full and around sixth stump, and the line of the ball turns out to be quite wide for Jurel to execute that sweep shot. The ball ends up going flat to Kishan, the centurion from earlier in the day, and SRH take another step closer to victory. Jurel fought hard for RR, but there was too much to get
this is full and just outside off, and turns away. Cut away on the bounce to point

top edge, and gone! All Klaasen has to do is move a few steps back, and to his right, before taking it with a reverse cup. A slower-ball bouncer from Harshal, as he went short and wide-ish of off. The ball came back in to finish around off, while also bouncing considerably. Samson went pulling, but his top hand came off the bat, and the ball went off the top edge
goes inside out over extra cover! Slower ball from Harshal, who goes on a length, and slightly wide of off. Samson waits for it to arrive, before tonking at it
short in length, and around seventh stump. Pulled to deep midwicket
he goes off balance, and lofts it on the bounce to deep cover! Samson reaches out at this wide yorker outside off, and his bottom hand also comes off in trying to play at that
on a fullish length, and again wide of off. Samson pushes it to extra cover after playing away from his body
on the shorter side of a length, and again wide-ish of off. Jurel cuts it late towards deep cover
on a length, and very wide outside off. Left alone by Jurel, and it is called wide
one-bounce four over extra cover! Samson is deep in the crease, and he lofts this length delivery outside off by reaching out for the ball. A powerful shot for four
short in length, and pretty wide of off. He reaches out to slash to deep cover
wow, drilled back over the bowler's head! This is the cleanest of hits today. Simarjeet bowled on a fullish length, and around off, as Jurel lofted with a high left elbow to laucnh that
change of pace, and short and around sixth stump. Jurel jumped to try and ramp again, but missed. Wide called, and also a second bouncer
classy shot for six! The shot of the day, you'd think! He stands still, and just opens the face of the bat to upper cut at this short-of-a-length ball just outside off. Six over short third
bam! Dispatched deep over long-off! That's also Jurel's fifty. On a length from Simarjeet, with the line being arund fifth stump. Jurel waited and just lofted through the line

Cummins, at extra cover, tumbles to his left to prevent at least one run. Simarjeet bowled on a length, and wide of off, as Samson slashed at it away from his body. It's a no-ball from Simarjeet, though
bowls a slower-ball bouncer. It pitched short and around off, as Samson looked to leap and ramp but missed
reaches out to cut but is beaten for pace. Was also a lot fuller than he anticipated

dropped by Shami at short fine!  Withers because of the sting he received because the ball smacked his left palm as he put his hand out to catch. He was in no position to catch that.  Shami is immediately leaving the field.  This was a slower ball on middle and leg that Samson was looking to pick up over short fine
driven to sweeper cover
cramped for room as he tries to flat-bat that, Cummins puts his left hand out on his followthrough to stop that
no power behind the cut, hits it straight to the fielder
cutter outside off, scythed over the infield to deep point
punched to long-off, tight over from Zampa
pulled to wide long-on
cracking cut but that's an outstanding stop at point by Simarjeet, saved four!
makes room to go inside-out, Zampa drifts one in to cramp Jurel as he defends
drives inside-out to long-off
drills this full toss to extra cover where Cummins throws himself to his left to save at least two.
pulled to deep square as Harshal bowls a cutter into the pitch to cramp him for rom
hacked to wide long-on, Sanju brings up a 26-ball fifty that keeps RR afloat
cut away, a half-stop at point keeps it to a single. Harshal shortened his length as he bowled another slower delivery
walloped through the line to clear long-on! Jurel picked length early and went through with the stoke to clear the ropes effortlessly.
dipping slower delivery angling into middle, tucked to the leg side
starts with a cutter outside Samson's hitting arc, beaten as he swings through
swept up and over to beat the man at short fine, dribbles away to the boundary.
worked down to deep midwicket
mistimes a pull, was into the shot way too early. Gets it off the bottom as it rolls to short fine
pulled away to wide long-on, btw the 50 of the partnership came up with the six.
fired full and down leg, paddled straight to short fine
makes room and lofts him inside-out to clear deep cover! Lovely improvisation from Jurel. Incredible stoke play
drilled straight back over the bowler's head, timing and placement top notch!
flatter and fuller, pushed back past the bowler who misfields. Easy run conceded. Zampa annoyed by the non-striker standing in his way
bowls a quicker one that fizzes through, Samson manages to but it between cover and mid-off for a single
cuts uppishly, hit straight to point
right in his hitting arc and Samson clears his front leg and swings him down the ground and into the sightscreen
cut away to deep point, into the gap there for a couple. Good work by NKR
reaches out to drive this straight to cover
bunts this flatter one to cover
drilled down to long-on, and this bursts through the fielder's hands to the boundary. Youngster Aniket Verma has a sheepish look in embarrassment.
works it to deep midwicket as he jogs the single

beats the outside edge with a sharp turner,  Klaasen whips the bails off and asks for it to be referred upstairs.  They're checking if Samson's back foot was outside the crease. No one's terribly excited about the appeal, the stumps have been nailed back in and everyone's in their position, but jeez this is close. This one spun away quickly and across the face of the bat. Samson's back leg was in the air for a long, long time. The third umpire has had a few looks at the replay. A call is awaited. Looks like he's been given not out.
fires one full outside off from around the stumps, Samson lets it go anticipating it to be a wide, not given
just wide of Shami at short fine leg! Short in length on middle, and Jurel swivelled to pull it behind the wicket. He seemed to be beaten by the lack of pace, though, but still got four
short in length from Cummins, and around fifth stump. There's some extra bounce, but Samson rides it to swat-pull to deep midwicket
slower ball, and on a short of a length. The line is wide of off, and Jurel cuts hard to deep-backward point

missed chance by Cummins! And, almost stunningly, it goes for four! He only leans into this push forward off this length delivery around off, and nearly chips it back to Cummins' right. Cummins threw his hand out, but the ball didn't even touch it
clipped to deep square leg! On a full length from Cummins, who swings the ball in nicely to pitch it on middle. Jurel reads the movement, and bags four after the six first ball
sent deep into the stands first ball! Jurel stays deep in the crease, and absolutely hammers this length delivery which is slightly wide of off. Six over long-on

whipped to deep square leg! Great effort running and diving to his left by Reddy, but the ball hits his hand and then the rope. Shami bowled this full and straight, and Samson, even from deep in the crease, flicked it away for four despite the length being quite full
on a good length on off, and he hops in the crease to push it wide of mid-on
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. He's almost surprised by the extra bounce, before he manages to slash it towards point
on a good length on middle, as the ball swings in nicely. Jurel clips it towards deep midwicket to get off the mark with two
on the shorter shorter side of a length, and just about on off. Tapped to point by Jurel

gone! Skied to mid-off for another simple catch for Cummins! Shami bowled it with an upright seam, and angled the ball in from around the wicket. He pitched it on the fuller side of a length around off, with no movement off the pitch. Rana was deep in the crease, and went lofting at this ball. But the length could ideally have been fuller, and he only mistimed it to fall in the powerplay

punched to deep-backward point... and Reddy, chasing and tumbling to his right from deep third, sees the ball go below him! The ball was on a good length, and around sixth stump, as Samson played at it powerfully to bag four more
ramped over short third! Simarjeet again bowls short and wide of off, although the line this time is much closer to off. Samson has a little leap in the crease, and sends the ball flying for six
he stands with a bit of a room, and Simarjeet goes short and wide of off. Left alone by Samson, and it is called wide
on a length on the stumps, and he nudges this to midwicket, where the man is standing right on the edge of the circle
thumped over midwicket! Short in length from Simarjeet, who pitched the ball just outside off, before getting it to move back in. Samson was deep in the crease, and pulled it for four
on a fullish length, and just outside off. Samson shaped to come forward, before shifting his weight back and pushing towards short third
on the shorter side of a length, and in the corridor just outside off. Samson looked to pull but missed, as the ball seemed to have stayed low
angled in, and on a length around fifth stump. Rana looked to cut at it late, but the ball straightened after pitching, and he was beaten

bottom edge, but wide of the stumps! Klaasen dived to his right and got a hand to take the sting off the ball. Shami went on a good length just outside off, and Rana looked to cut. But the line seemed to be too close for that shot
pulled over mid-on! Another ball from wide of the crease from Shami, who bowled this short, and around off. Rana is standing deep in the crease, and is able to slam the ball back
fuller ball, and outside off. Driven to cover this time

outside edge, but wide of slip! There was a short third in place too, but the ball went in the gap there. Shami angled this in and bowled on a length just outside off. The ball seemed to straighten after pitching, and as Rana looked to flick with a half-closed face of the bat, he ended up getting an outside edge
Shami goes wide of the crease, and bowls on the shorter side of a length and wide outside off. Rana goes jabbing at it, but is beaten by the movement back in after pitching
shorter side of a length on middle. He swivels to pull to fine leg, and gets off the mark

taken at mid-on! Parag perishes searching for another boundary! Simarjeet strikes twice within three balls. He bowled this short and just outside off, and with a scrambled seam. Parag looked to shift his weight back and pull this back, but ended up getting it off the higher side of the bat. Cummins, at mid-on, moved a step back and to his left to take with a reverse cup
swiped to deep-backward square leg! On a length on off, with a hint of movement back in after pitching, as Parag, with his head down, whacks at it effortlessly

superb catch by Manohar! The orange army at the ground yells its throat out! Manohar, at point, leapt up full stretch, and managed to grab the ball in his left hand. He couldn't have jumped any higher, and Simarjeet couldn't have been happier. He bowled short and wide of off, as Jaiswal went to cut and even got good height, only for Manohar to interfere

extra bounce, and four byes for RR! Simarjeet bowled this short in length, and pitched this on middle and off or thereabouts. Jaiswal went hooking but was beaten by the bounce, as was Klaasen, the wicketkeeper
on a short of a length on leg, as Jaiswal went pulling but missed. The ball shaped away slightly, and went over the stumps

slapped to deep point! On the shorter side of a length from Shami, who bowls this around middle and off. The ball moves away again after pitching, and despite there not being too much of a room, Samson manages to chop it away for four more
between point and cover point! Another ball on a short of a length, and this pitches wide of off, before shaping away. Samson reaches out, and cuts it hard for four

into the first tier! Samson hooks hard and deep over fine leg! Short in length from Shami, who bowls around off, before the ball seams back in. Samson reads the length and the movement, and clubs it away
Short of a length around fifth stump, before it seams away. Samson slashes at it, and plays on the bounce to the man at cover point
shorter side of a length around sixth stump, and slapped towards the man at deep-backward point

Shami goes wide of the crease, and pitches it on a good length and wide of off. Jaiswal looks to cut at it far away from his body, and misses. It is called wide, as the ball shapes away after pitching
on a length on sixth stump, and the ball seams away, even as Jaiswal looks to loft but is beaten
